g.text: AI Content Understanding + Content Safety | Purchase Order Guardrails
Salesforce → Azure Function → Content Understanding → Content Safety → Conditional SAP Routing
Extracted fields routed to Content Safety
• Scans document text for system prompt overrides
• Detects jailbreaks hidden in shipping instructions
• Flags credit cards, SSNs, personal banking IBANs
• In-memory redaction before SAP ERP persistence
• Denied parties list & OFAC sanctions checks
• EAR99 vs ITAR dual-use restricted hardware
• Automated quarantine if severity exceeds threshold
🚫 NO DIRECT FILE-TO-ERP PATH | Guardrails happen in-flight BEFORE downstream ERP persistence or transaction execution.
• Zero hard-coded credentials in source code
• Real-time threat telemetry dashboard for SOC
• End-to-end correlation ID linking Salesforce & SAP
• Kusto (KQL) audit queries for compliance audits
Large Context Document Protection (10+ to 22+ Page Orders)
Sliding-Window Token Windowing & Parallel Chunk Scanning

svg.text: Michael Yaacoub | Sr Solution Engineer • Microsoft Customer Success & Enterprise AI Architecture • GitHub: csdmichael/AI-Content-Understanding-POC
